description: A native formula \(I\) is a uniform interpolant of \(A\) over a finite vocabulary \(S\) when \(A\models I\), \(\operatorname{at}(I)\subseteq S\), and every \(B\) with \(\operatorname{at}(B)\cap\operatorname{at}(A)\subseteq S\) and \(A\models B\) satisfies \(I\models B\). The same \(I\) works for all such \(B\).
